title: No space left on device: /var/crash is full of core dumps
description_md:
The `render-worker` job keeps crashing, and every crash leaves a full core dump behind in `/var/crash` -- someone left core dumping wide open (`ulimit -c unlimited`) for a binary that segfaults constantly, and now that filesystem is completely full. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), clean up the accumulated dumps, and fix the actual problem so this doesn't just fill back up the next time it crashes.

You're done when `/var/crash` has a healthy amount of free space again, *and* triggering the worker's crash loop one more time doesn't leave a fresh core dump behind.
